 Dated : 3rd November 2025
 Pc:-
1. Heard Ms. Priyanka Chavan, learned Counsel appearing for the Applicant and Mr. Metkari,
learned App appearing for the Respondent-State.
2.

This application is filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking
pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R. No.561 of 2018 registered with Shirur Police Station, Pune,
for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 409 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

Page 1 Sonali 608-Aba1929-2022.Doc
3.
The FIR has been lodged on 26 th July 2018.

As per the prosecution case, there has been misappropriation of funds to the tune of Rs.4,21,75,245/- in Shirur Group Vividh Karyakari Seva Co-operative Society by the Secretary of the Society i.e. accused No.1-Chandrakant Sangle.

sentences.text:
1 Inspector/Development Officer of District Central Co-operative Bank Limited, Ghodnadi Branch,
Pune.

The role assigned to the Applicant is that the District Central Co-operative Bank Limited disbursed loans to the members of Shirur Group Vividh Karyakari Seva Co-operative Society when already there were outstanding dues of the loans that were not repaid.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
As per the prosecution case,
the present Applicant in conspiracy with the accused No.1- Chandrakant Sangle have misappropriated the above mentioned amounts.
4. It is the contention of Ms. Chavan, learned Counsel appearing for the Applicant that the liability which has been imposed by the Cooperation Department is Rs.20,06,252/-.
She submits that as per the FIR, the said liability is Rs.2 crores.

She submits that the Applicant's account in Pune District Co-operative Page 2 Sonali 608-ABA1929-2022.DOC Society Bank, Pune has been freezed and in the said account, an amount of Rs.20,02,198 is available.
She points out the order dated 29th August 2022 passed by a learned Single Judge.

The said order reads as under:
".

This is an Application under section 438 of Cr.P.C. for pre-arrest bail in C.R.No.561/2018 registered with Shirur Police Station, Dist. Pune Rural for offences punishable under sections 420, 406, 409 r/w. 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Shirur Police Station, Dist. Pune Rural
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. Heard Ms. Chavan, learned counsel for the Applicant and Mr. Gaikwad, learned APP for the State.
I have perused the records and considered the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the respective parties.

3. The aforesaid crime was registered pursuant to the First Information Report (FIR)
lodged by one Rajesh Sudam Bhujbal.

It is the case of the prosecution that Chandrakant Sangale, the Secretary of a registered Society viz. Vividh Karyakari Seva Sahakari Sanstha Maryadit has misappropriated an amount of Rs.4,21,75,245/-.

entities.text: Vividh Karyakari Seva Sahakari Sanstha Maryadit
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
It is stated that the Applicant was a Bank Development Officer during the year 2015-16 and that in collusion and connivance with the said Secretary, the Applicant had disbursed amount to 235 members and the misappropriation was to the tune of Rs.1,31,21,376/-.
4.

The records prima facie indicate that even before the audit, the Applicant had addressed letters to the Secretary of the Society with copy to the Sub- Registrar of the Co-operative Society bringing to Page 3 Sonali 608-ABA1929-2022.DOC their notice several irregularities in disbursal of the loan.

The records further indicate that though the crime was registered in the year 2018 and till date, no interim relief was operating in favour of the Applicant, the investigating Agency had not tried to secure presence of the Applicant and no attempts were made to arrest or to investigate him.
5.
Considering the above facts and circumstances, in my considered view, the Applicant is entitled for interim protection till the next date of hearing.

Hence, the following order :-

sentences.text: (a) In the event of arrest of the Applicant in C.R.No.561/2018 registered with Shirur Police Station, Dist. Pune Rural, he shall be released on interim bail, on furnishing P.R. bonds in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one or more sureties in the like amount ;

entities.text: Shirur Police Station, Dist. Pune Rural
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
(b) The Applicant shall report to the Investigating Officer for three days from 05/09/2022 from 10:00 a.m. to 01:00 p.m.
(c) The Applicant shall not interfere with the complainant and the other prosecution witnesses and shall not tamper with the evidence or attempt to influence or contact the complainant, witnesses or any person concerned with the case in any manner ;
(d) The Applicant shall keep the Investigating Officer informed of his current address and mobile contact numbers, and/or change of residence or mobile details, if any,
from time to time.
6. Stand over to 19/09/2022."
Page 4 Sonali 608-ABA1929-2022.DOC 5.
The FIR is concerning the loan transactions which have took place between 1st April 2009 to 31st March 2015.
The FIR is lodged on 26th July 2018.
The investigation is completed.
The Applicant is having protection of pre-arrest bail for last more than three years.

Accordingly, the case is made out for grant of Anticipatory Bail in terms of the order dated 29th August 2025.
6.
The Anticipatory Bail Application is disposed of accordingly.
